note: Fill the `text` of everything marked todo: lines, chapters, the title, the description, the tags. The rest already has a current translation. Keep `id`, `scene`, `source` and `todo` as they are. `thumbnail.text` holds the words of this locale's own thumbnail, one for each word in `thumbnail.source` (tag, headline, sub): short enough to read on a phone, with the same `**` emphasis and line breaks. `max_chars` is how many characters a line's dub may have (docs/videos/DUBS.md): the translation is also read aloud in the time the narration line takes, so stay under it. `glossary.terms` are the dictionary terms this video uses, in the forms they appear in, and `glossary.sources` the names of its sources: render each one way everywhere, a product, company, model or feature name as its maker writes it. `boundaries` maps a line id to the pieces the narration's captions cut that line into (a line absent from it is one cue): keep the clauses in that order.

title.source: 用 AI 比較三份 PDF 報價：最低單價，真的最便宜？
title.text: Compare 3 PDF Quotes with AI: Is the Lowest Unit Price Really Cheapest?

description.source:
三份 PDF 報價的單價不能直接放在一起排序。跟著同一組原創明信片報價，讓 AI 先整理規格、數量、含稅狀態、運費與來源頁碼，再用明示條件算出可比較的送達總價。收到修訂版、把數量從十張改成二十張後，重新核對結果。

示範使用本次 Codex AI 文件分析、pypdf 文字抽取與精確小數計算，輸出可編輯試算表；不宣稱已實測任何特定商用 AI 產品的上傳介面。供應商、價格及百分之五稅率均是原創練習設定，不是對真實交易的稅務判斷。

資料與實作日期：2026-10-26。本次 PDF 可選取文字；這條抽文流程不做掃描影像 OCR。試算表中的數值由計算工具實際計算，openpyxl 只負責寫檔，不宣稱它會計算公式。

教材包含需求、提示詞、來源 PDF 生成程式、逐頁抽文、可編輯比價表與版本紀錄。

畫面七行提示詞為觀眾任務要求；機讀欄位格式另見 analysis-prompt.txt 的 JSON 契約，本次 AI 分析也讀取了該契約。

原創教材、需求與完整提示詞：
https://github.com/x812033727/travel_scanner/tree/53e7243ba84b2327f7a7674acc8065f411088d96/docs/videos/ai-pdf-quotes-to-comparison/materials
description.text:
You cannot simply sort the unit prices in three PDF quotes. Follow one original set of postcard quotes: have AI organize specifications, quantities, tax status, shipping and source page numbers, then use the stated terms to calculate comparable delivered totals. Check the results again after receiving a revision and changing the quantity from 10 cards to 20.

This demo uses Codex AI document analysis, pypdf text extraction and exact decimal calculations to produce an editable spreadsheet. It does not claim to have tested the upload interface of any particular commercial AI product. The suppliers, prices and 5% tax rate are original practice settings, not tax advice for real transactions.

Data and implementation date: 2026-10-26. These PDFs have selectable text; this text extraction workflow does not perform OCR on scanned images. The spreadsheet values were actually calculated by a calculation tool. openpyxl only writes the file; no claim is made that it calculates formulas.

The materials include requirements, prompts, a source PDF generator, page-by-page extracted text, an editable quote comparison sheet and version records.

The seven-line prompt on screen gives the viewer's task requirements. The machine-readable field format is specified separately in the JSON contract in analysis-prompt.txt; this AI analysis also read that contract.

Original materials, requirements and full prompts:
https://github.com/x812033727/travel_scanner/tree/53e7243ba84b2327f7a7674acc8065f411088d96/docs/videos/ai-pdf-quotes-to-comparison/materials

source.tag: AI 比較 PDF 報價
source.headline: **先算總價**

chapters.text: Can the lowest unit price win?

chapters.source: 讓每個欄位都找得到原文
含稅和運費要算到同一個終點
把缺漏變成能寄出的問題
修訂版到手，只替換改過的條件
數量翻倍，重新確認適用條件
只多一張，最低價在哪裡換人？
chapters.text: One more card, a new winner?

sources: pypdf — Extract Text from a PDF

7dp4: 先把原本十張的數量設定檔，
另存成畫面上這個新檔名，再把數量改成二十。

lines.source: 最低的單價，現在還不能直接排第一。
lines.text: The lowest unit price cannot rank first just yet.

lines.source: 因為這三份報價，寫的其實不是同一種金額。
lines.text: These three quotes state different kinds of amounts.

lines.source: 所以我們讓 AI 做一張能編輯的表，連原文頁碼也一起留下。
lines.text: So we ask AI for an editable table, keeping the source page numbers too.

lines.source: 但空白的運費，能不能直接當成免費？
lines.text: But can blank shipping just mean free delivery?

lines.source: 補來一張修訂單，便宜的會換人嗎？
lines.text: Will a revised quote change which is cheapest?

lines.source: 如果數量翻倍，原本的答案還能用嗎？
lines.text: If the quantity doubles, does the old answer still hold?

lines.source: 你現在要印十張明信片，三家都寄來了報價。
lines.text: You need 10 postcards; all three sent quotes.

lines.source: 先把自己的需求另存一份，別讓報價替你決定要買什麼。
lines.text: Save your needs first; don't let quotes decide what you should buy.

lines.source: 像紙張、尺寸和印刷方式，都要能逐項對上。
lines.text: Match paper, dimensions and printing method item by item.

lines.source: 只寫明信片還不夠，換一種紙就可能是另一個價格。
lines.text: Just 'postcards' won't do; changing paper may change the price.

lines.source: 交貨地址和期限也要相同，才是在比同一件事。
lines.text: Match address and deadline for a fair comparison.

lines.source: 這次要的是送達總價，單價只是其中一個欄位。
lines.text: We need the delivered total; unit price is just one field.

lines.source: 三份原檔先保留下來，輸出另外放一個資料夾。
lines.text: Keep all three originals; put outputs in another folder.

lines.source: 這樣你收到新版本，還能看出供應商到底改了什麼。
lines.text: Then a new version lets you see what the supplier changed.

lines.source: 這組供應商和交易條件，都是練習用的虛構資料。
lines.text: These suppliers and terms are fictional practice data.

lines.source: 畫面上的稅率是計算假設，真實交易要用自己的報價條件。
lines.text: The tax rate is assumed; for real deals, use your own quote terms.

lines.source: 你可以讓 AI 幫忙整理欄位，再把算術交給計算工具。
lines.text: Let AI sort fields, then let a tool do the arithmetic.

lines.source: 把這兩件事拆開，錯了才知道該回頭看文字還是公式。
lines.text: Separate them to trace errors back to the text or the formula.

lines.source: 甲的單價在第一頁，送貨條件卻放在第二頁。
lines.text: Aster's unit price is on page 1; delivery terms are on page 2.

lines.source: 如果只讀首頁，這張比較表一開始就少了一筆錢。
lines.text: Read only page 1, and the comparison starts with a cost missing.

lines.source: 所以我們把每份報價的兩頁文字，都連同需求交給 AI。
lines.text: So we give AI both pages of each quote, with our requirements.

lines.source: 而且要它每個欄位都附上原文，別只回一句哪家比較划算。
lines.text: Ask for source text for every field, not just which supplier is cheaper.

lines.source: 缺的就保留空值，單價和運費各自的稅，也要分清楚。
lines.text: Keep missing values null; separate the taxes on unit price and shipping too.

lines.source: 三家版面不同，所以先訂好共同欄位，才不會照著排版亂比。
lines.text: The layouts differ: set shared fields first to avoid comparing by layout.

lines.source: 原文是含稅價，就保留含稅價，不要急著把所有數字加在一起。
lines.text: Keep tax-inclusive prices as quoted; don't rush to add all the numbers.

lines.source: 甲分在兩頁的單價和運費，表格接成同一列，各自留著出處。
lines.text: Join Aster's unit price and shipping from two pages in one row, each sourced.

lines.source: 拿這段原句，就能核對表格有沒有把運費漏掉。
lines.text: Use this quote to check for missing shipping costs.

lines.source: 同樣是運費，為什麼乙能填零，丙卻不行？
lines.text: Why can Birch's shipping be zero, but Cedar's cannot?

lines.source: 乙的運費填零，是因為它的報價明寫免費送達。
lines.text: Birch's shipping is zero: its quote states delivery is free.

lines.source: 丙的第二頁則寫運費沒有報價，這是另一種狀態。
lines.text: Cedar's page 2 has no shipping quote. It's different.

lines.source: AI 應該保留這個差別，不能為了把表填滿就補上零。
lines.text: AI must keep that distinction, not add zero just to fill the table.

lines.source: 後面算總價時，程式看到這個空值，就知道還不能當成完整報價。
lines.text: When calculating totals, this null tells the program the quote is still incomplete.

lines.source: 拿到表格後，先挑會改變答案的值回到原頁核對。
lines.text: Check values that may change the answer on the source page.

lines.source: 逐欄對照數值和支持它的原句；對不上，就先標成待確認。
lines.text: Check each field's value against its supporting quote; if they differ, mark it unconfirmed.

lines.source: 如果只是把單價從小排到大，丙看起來會最便宜。
lines.text: Sort unit prices low to high, and Cedar looks cheapest.

lines.source: 可是這個排序，還沒有把稅和送達費用放進來。
lines.text: But this ranking still excludes tax and delivery costs.

lines.source: 先把這個排序留下來，等送達總價算完，再對照名次差在哪。
lines.text: Keep this ranking; after calculating delivered totals, compare what changed.

lines.source: 甲的商品和運費都明示未稅，所以兩邊各算自己的稅。
lines.text: Aster states goods and shipping pre-tax; tax each.

lines.source: 把這幾項合起來，才是甲這份報價的送達總價。
lines.text: Add these items to get Aster's delivered total for this quote.

lines.source: 乙的單價已經含商品稅，直接乘數量就能得到商品金額。
lines.text: Birch's tax-inclusive unit price times quantity gives goods cost.

lines.source: 那丙的商品稅也算得出來，它能一起排進名次嗎？
lines.text: Cedar's goods tax is calculable too. Can we also rank it?

lines.source: 結果算到同一個終點，目前是乙比甲便宜。
lines.text: For delivered totals, Birch is cheaper than Aster.

lines.source: 丙的總價仍待確認，所以不能把它排成第一名。
lines.text: Cedar's total is still unconfirmed, so it cannot rank first.

lines.source: 碰到小數時，讓計算工具依明示條件計算，再統一金額格式。
lines.text: For decimals, let a tool apply stated terms, then standardize money formats.

lines.source: 不要讓模型先四捨五入單價，再把誤差一路乘上數量。
lines.text: Don't let the model round unit prices first and multiply that error by quantity.

lines.source: 打開試算表，把原文金額和計算金額分開核對。
lines.text: Open it; check quoted and computed amounts separately.

lines.source: 但它不是會自己重算的公式，需求一改，就要重新產生一次結果。
lines.text: These are not formulas that recalculate: regenerate the results whenever requirements change.

lines.source: 還記得那個空白的運費嗎？現在它直接決定丙能不能排進名次。
lines.text: Remember blank shipping? It now decides whether Cedar can be ranked.

lines.source: 因為丙的商品比乙便宜，只要運費不夠高，名次就會翻過來。
lines.text: Cedar's goods cost less than Birch's; low enough shipping would reverse the ranking.

lines.source: 表格把丙拆成已知跟未知，未知的是運費、運費是否含稅，還有稅額。
lines.text: The table splits Cedar into known and unknown: shipping, its tax status and tax amount are unknown.

lines.source: 所以問題要問得具體，請它補送到同一地址的運費和稅。
lines.text: Ask specifically for shipping and its tax to that same address.

lines.source: 也要確認數量改變後費用是否相同，免得下一輪又得猜。
lines.text: Check if costs stay the same when quantity changes, to avoid guessing again.

lines.source: AI 可以幫你整理待問清單，但詢問草稿還需要你確認。
lines.text: AI can list questions, but you still need to check the draft.

lines.source: 別把表格裡的待確認，寫成供應商已經同意的條件。
lines.text: Don't turn unconfirmed fields into terms the supplier has agreed to.

lines.source: 你也可以讓表格多一個狀態欄位，寫清楚它卡在哪裡。
lines.text: Add a status field to show exactly what is holding it up.

lines.source: 真正的報價如果規格不同，先問能不能對齊，別自己編一個升級價。
lines.text: If real quotes differ in specification, ask if they can match; don't invent an upgrade price.

lines.source: 丙補來了修訂版，這時候不要把它當成第四家供應商。
lines.text: Cedar sent a revision. Don't count it as a fourth supplier.

lines.source: 留下舊檔作紀錄，再用新的條件替換丙這一列。
lines.text: Keep the old file; replace Cedar's row with the new terms.

lines.source: 先核對這裡列的舊版編號，再把對應的舊檔標成已被取代。
lines.text: Check the old version number listed here, then mark the matching old file as superseded.

lines.source: 這次改的是運費和它的稅，商品單價並沒有跟著變。
lines.text: Only shipping and its tax changed; the goods unit price did not.

lines.source: 好，現在丙的送達總價算得出來了，結果剛好和甲一樣。
lines.text: Now we can calculate Cedar's delivered total: exactly the same as Aster's.

lines.source: 運費補齊後，丙比乙多了五十元，還追不上。
lines.text: With shipping filled in, Cedar still costs TWD 50 more than Birch.

lines.source: 這時候還要看一眼來源這個欄位，有沒有改成對應修訂版。
lines.text: Also check the source field points to the correct revision.

lines.source: 只換了金額卻還連著舊檔，別人回頭核對時就會找不到。
lines.text: New amounts linked to an old file will leave others unable to trace them back.

lines.source: 後來你的需求改了，同樣的明信片，要印二十張。
lines.text: Your needs then change: 20 of the same postcards.

lines.source: 先把原本十張的數量設定檔，另存成畫面上這個新檔名，再把數量改成二十。
lines.text: Save the original 10-card settings file under the new name shown, then change the quantity to 20.

lines.source: 你改的是需求數量，不是把原本的總價直接乘上兩倍。
lines.text: Change the needed quantity; don't just double the old total.

lines.source: 情境這個欄位要保留修訂版，別切回原始報價。
lines.text: Keep the revised scenario; don't switch to the original.

lines.source: 數量改過之後，還要明說其他需求都不變。
lines.text: New quantity; say all other needs are unchanged.

lines.source: 先確認報價的適用範圍，再更新金額和來源，留下變動清單。
lines.text: Check the quote's scope first; then update amounts and sources, and list the changes.

lines.source: 存檔後，在教材的程式資料夾執行這條命令。
lines.text: Save; run this in the materials code folder.

lines.source: 它會讀取新數量，另存結果，不覆蓋供應商的原始報價。
lines.text: It reads the new count, saving results without overwriting the quotes.

lines.source: 打開輸出的需求紀錄，確認它真的使用了新的數量。
lines.text: Open the output request; check it used the new quantity.

lines.source: 再看供應商清單，丙應該只剩採用修訂版的那一列。
lines.text: Then check suppliers: Cedar should have only its revised row left.

lines.source: 這三份報價都寫明，單價在這段數量範圍內保持相同。
lines.text: All three quotes say unit prices stay fixed in this quantity range.

lines.source: 送貨條件也有對應的說明，所以我們這次能照新數量重算。
lines.text: Delivery terms cover it too, so we can recalculate for the new quantity.

lines.source: 甲的商品金額跟著數量增加，但運費還是那一筆。
lines.text: Aster's goods cost rises with quantity; shipping stays a single charge.

lines.source: 乙比甲多了一百一十元，原本的先後順序反過來了。
lines.text: Birch is TWD 110 above Aster; their old order is reversed.

lines.source: 那把丙也算進來，這個名次還會再變嗎？
lines.text: Will adding Cedar change this ranking again?

lines.source: 再看丙，它比甲少了五十二元五角。
lines.text: Now Cedar costs TWD 52.50 less than Aster.

lines.source: 還記得開頭問的數量翻倍嗎？最低總價真的換人了，變成丙。
lines.text: Remember doubling quantity? The lowest delivered total really changed to Cedar.

lines.source: 不是誰突然降價，而是固定運費在不同張數下，占的比例變了。
lines.text: No supplier cut its price; fixed shipping accounts for a different share at different quantities.

lines.source: 那最低總價是從第幾張開始換人？
lines.text: At what quantity does the winner change?

lines.source: 我們拿相鄰的兩個需求來試，不去猜所有張數都用同一個排名。
lines.text: We test two neighboring quantities, rather than assume one ranking holds for every quantity.

lines.source: 先把修訂情境另存一份，數量填十二，其他條件保持相同。
lines.text: Save the revised scenario as a copy; set quantity to 12, all else unchanged.

lines.source: 用同一份抽取資料執行，結果另存到這一份需求的資料夾。
lines.text: Run with the same extracted data; save results in this request's own folder.

lines.source: 再複製這份需求，只多加一張，留下另一個檔名。
lines.text: Copy this request, add just one card and use another file name.

lines.source: 輸出位置也要分開，這樣兩份結果才能真的並排比較。
lines.text: Use separate output folders too, so you can compare results side by side.

lines.source: 十二張時，乙只比丙少七元五角，還沒有換人。
lines.text: At 12, Birch is just TWD 7.50 below Cedar; no change yet.

lines.source: 十三張時，丙就領先十三元七角五分，這一步才跨過轉換點。
lines.text: At 13, Cedar leads by TWD 13.75: this step crosses the switch point.

lines.source: 差額都用丙減乙，正數是丙較貴，負數就是丙較便宜。
lines.text: Use Cedar minus Birch: positive means Cedar costs more, negative less.

lines.source: 每多一張，丙相對乙追回二十一元兩角五分，所以差額跨過了零。
lines.text: Each extra card gains Cedar TWD 21.25 against Birch, so the difference crosses zero.

lines.source: 二十張的需求如果再多要一張，變成二十一張，答案還算得出來嗎？
lines.text: Add one to the 20-card request, making 21: can we still get an answer?

lines.source: 這次先別改單價，照同一個方法重算看看。
lines.text: Keep unit prices for now; recalculate the same way.

lines.source: 只換需求檔和輸出資料夾，其他輸入都不變。
lines.text: Change only the request file and output folder; all other inputs stay the same.

lines.source: 程式會先拿新數量，對照各家寫明的適用範圍。
lines.text: First it checks the new quantity against each quote's stated range.

lines.source: 結果它拒絕計算，也沒有建立新的結果資料夾。
lines.text: It refuses to calculate and creates no new results folder.

lines.source: 因為二十一張，已經超過這三份報價寫明的範圍。
lines.text: Because 21 cards exceeds the range stated in all three quotes.

lines.source: 如果真的需要這個數量，就請供應商重報這一版條件。
lines.text: If you need this quantity, ask suppliers to requote these terms.

lines.source: 你最常遇到哪個報價欄位沒寫清楚，留言告訴我。
lines.text: Which quote fields are often unclear? Comment.

lines.source: 訂閱這個頻道，繼續把 AI 用成能交付的工作成果。
lines.text: Subscribe to keep turning AI into work you can deliver.
